technique_name: Compare and contrast weather and climate.
description: Weather and climate are both related to atmospheric conditions. Weather is the short-term atmospheric conditions that occur over a single day, or even a few hours. It consists of temperature, precipitation, thunderstorms, winds and other short-term atmospheric phenomena and is constantly changing. Climate, on the other hand, is the average weather conditions that occur over a long period of time (usually at least 30 years), and is relatively consistent in an area.
